audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds. Both cached and fresh computation paths use identical inputs: (1) effective balances are updated only at epoch boundaries in process_single_effective_balance_update; (2) active validator set is constant within epoch since exit_epoch is set to current_epoch + 1 + MAX_SEED_LOOKAHEAD; (3) randao_mix for proposer seed comes from epoch - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD - 1, which is not modified during current epoch. Cache is updated in process_proposer_lookahead after effective balance updates, ensuring consistency.
